## `Alert` { #alert-static-class }

`public static class Alert`

A modal message with one to three buttons.

```csharp
Alert.Show(Application, "Delete photo?", "This cannot be undone.", "Delete",
    onConfirm: Delete, dismissLabel: "Cancel",
    options: new AlertOptions { Destructive = true });
```

**Methods**

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static OverlayHandle Show(XenoApp app, string title, string message, AlertOptions options)` |  |
| `static OverlayHandle Show(XenoApp app, string title, string message, string confirmLabel = "OK", Action onConfirm = null, string dismissLabel = null, Action onDismiss = null, AlertOptions options = null)` |  |
| `static XenoComponent Content(string title, string message, AlertOptions options, Action dismiss)` | The alert's inside (icon, texts, buttons), without the dialog card. |

## `Popup` { #popup-static-class }

`public static class Popup`

A small floating panel next to the element that opened it: menus, pickers, tooltips with content. Touching anywhere else closes it without reaching the page.

```csharp
Button("More", () => Popup.ShowMenu(Application,
    new PopupItem("Rename", Rename), new PopupItem("Delete", Delete, Destructive: true)));
```

**Methods**

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static OverlayHandle Show(XenoApp app, Func<OverlayHandle, XenoComponent> content, PopupOptions options = null)` |  |
| `static OverlayHandle ShowMenu(XenoApp app, PopupOptions options, params PopupItem[] items)` |  |
| `static OverlayHandle ShowMenu(XenoApp app, params PopupItem[] items)` | A menu: rows that run their action and close the popup. |
| `static XenoComponent Menu(IReadOnlyList<PopupItem> items, Action dismiss, PopupOptions style = null)` | The menu's rows, for previews and custom hosts. |
| `static XenoComponent Surface(XenoComponent content, PopupOptions options)` | The popup card around `content`. |

## `Snackbar` { #snackbar-static-class }

`public static class Snackbar`

A short message at the screen edge that disappears by itself. Non-modal: the page stays usable. Showing a snackbar replaces the one on screen.

```csharp
Snackbar.Show(Application, "Message deleted", new SnackbarOptions
{
    ActionLabel = "Undo", OnAction = Restore,
    Animation = OverlayAnimation.Scale(200)      // any OverlayAnimation, or Custom(NavTransition)
});
```

**Methods**

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static OverlayHandle Show(XenoApp app, Func<OverlayHandle, XenoComponent> content, SnackbarOptions options = null)` | Shows fully custom content in the snackbar's placement, timing and motion. |
| `static OverlayHandle Show(XenoApp app, string message, SnackbarOptions options = null)` | Shows fully custom content in the snackbar's placement, timing and motion. |
| `static XenoComponent Body(string message, SnackbarOptions options, Action dismiss)` | The snackbar's visual, for previews or for composing it elsewhere. |
